comment.narrative: 1. The development of the Joint Lobby and Advocacy Strategy - NIMD and AMwA - 2022 2. The formation of the InterParty Women’s Platform (IWOP) and the development of its MoU and five year strategic plan. 3. The development of the Democratic Party gender policy and sexual harassment policy - 2022 4. The Post Independence Women Leaders’ Intergenerational Dialogue and action-plan - 2022 5. The dialogue and engagement by the InterParty Youth Platform (IYOP) which resulted in the development of the communique which calls for political party leaders to develop and enforce gender-responsive policy and practice - 2022 6. The Women Leaders’ Media Expo - 2022 7. Kenya CSOs Action Plan based on the Policy Engagement of February 2022 which was organized in partnership with Mzalendo Trust and AMwA 8. The Women in Politics Retreat which was held in 2023 where the women leaders set a Minimum Agenda 9. The National Youth Symposium - 2023 10. The CSO Consultative meeting and CSO Retreat which were held in 2022 and 2023 respectively and culminated in the development of the CSO Minimum Agenda which provides CSOs’ action-plans to safeguard and strengthen the democratic and civic space in Uganda, 11. The High Level Women Leaders’ Breakfast Meeting and action plans - 2023 12. Passing of the SRHR Bill at the East African Youth Parliament 13. Recommendations developed at the Regional Women in Politics Conference in 2022. Action points of the Post Women’s day regional webinar in 2021
